taste.name: Dim the Decimals
taste.trigger: When showing a large monetary figure
taste.decision: Printed the integer part in full white and decimals at ~40% opacity over uniform weight and colour
taste.reason: People read money's size from its leading digits; dimming the tail keeps precision without competing

taste.name: Glass Over Light
taste.trigger: When giving metric tiles depth on a coloured panel
taste.decision: Chose translucent tiles with a lighter 1px edge over a lit gradient over opaque shadowed cards
taste.reason: Translucency keeps the panel's light visible through the data, so figures feel part of one surface

taste.name: Round Controls, Stepped Containers
taste.decision: Chose pills and circles for controls with radii stepping 22 -> 18 -> 10 over square or single-radius UI
taste.reason: Round controls read as touchable and friendly, which a payments product needs to feel safe
evidence: CTA, email, badge, icon buttons fully round

taste.name: Quiet Headline
taste.decision: Chose sentence case, regular weight, plain white, no bold or gradient text over a heavy display headline
taste.reason: The dashboard below is the spectacle; a calm headline lets it carry the first screen
